name: Ghibli Park (overseas tickets)
intro: A Studio Ghibli park near Nagoya with full-size buildings and scenes from the films, spread across five areas. It is not a ride park. Tickets are sold online only for a set date, and a whole month goes on sale at once.

facts.price: Standard pass ¥3,300 to ¥3,800 for adults; Premium pass ¥7,300 to ¥7,800 (weekdays to weekends)
facts.bookAhead: Two months: tickets go on sale on the 10th, two months before

statusNote: Read from the official overseas ticket page.
howToBuy: Overseas tickets are sold online only, through LAWSON TICKET or Klook.
Tickets cannot be bought by phone or at the park.
Each ticket type can be bought once per month, up to six tickets per purchase.
rulesToKnow: Sale dates can change, so check the official page before the release day.

soldOut.label: Ghibli Park tickets on Klook (an official overseas seller)
Ghibli Museum in Tokyo: tickets open one month ahead

faq.q: When do Ghibli Park tickets go on sale for overseas visitors?
faq.a: On the 10th of each month at 14:00 Japan time, for visits two months later. For example, December tickets go on sale on October 10.

faq.q: Can I buy Ghibli Park tickets at the park?
faq.a: No. Tickets are sold online only.

sources.quote: Reservations for December 2026 go on sale October 10th 2026 at 2 p.m. (Japan time).
